svg.title: Weight loss, bladder leaks and vulvar diagnoses: three studies
svg.desc: Weight loss, bladder leaks and vulvar diagnoses: three studies. PRIDE trial (NEJM 2009), Drop in weekly leak episodes, 6 months: Weight loss 47%; Education 28%. Look AHEAD (J Urol 2012), New weekly incontinence after 1 year: Lifestyle 10.5%; Education 14.0%. TriNetX abstract (J Sex Med 2026), New coded vulvar atrophy or hypertrophy: GLP-1 users 0.061%; Non-users 0.06%.
